text: 🧱 THE DAILY BLOCK · WED 7 OCT ₿ BTC $84,200 (-1.6%) · ETH $2,618 (-2.9%) · Fear & Greed 71 🇮🇳 NIFTY 22,593 at the close (-0.5%) · SENSEX 72,636 (-0.6%) ⚡ The RBI hiked. India's central bank raised the repo rate a quarter-point to 5.50%, its first increase since February 2023, and turned its stance to calibrated tightening. Governor Malhotra said near-term cuts are off the table. The 25bp was expected. The hawkish signal was the surprise. 🇮🇳 Stocks fell then pared the losses. Banks gained on the higher-for-longer rate view, while rate-sensitive auto and property names lagged. The Nifty still closed down about half a percent. ⚡ Crypto had its own red day. Bitcoin slipped below $84,000 after buyers failed again above $87,000, and about $487M of bullish bets placed with borrowed money were force-closed over 24 hours. 🛢️ The trigger was macro, not crypto. Brent crude pushed above $101 after a tanker attack in the Middle East, and bond yields and the dollar firmed. Stocks and crypto fell together. 🎲 DEGEN WATCH: nearly $400M of positions were force-closed in a single hour. That is what borrowed money does when price turns: your position hits its limit and the exchange sells it for you, and each forced sale feeds the next. Spot holders just watched. Chase nothing.
